fact: The Ministry of Health's statistical review states that it has operated an integrated facility reporting system on KHIS since 2012 and that the national facility reporting rate, the average of five monthly forms (MOH 710, 711, 717, 705A and 705B), rose from 89.6% in 2016/17 to 96.6% in 2019/2020, with only Isiolo, Wajir and Mandera counties below 90%; it is a completeness figure and does not say whether facilities or sub-county offices key the reports.
title: Mid Term Review of the Kenya Health Sector Strategic and Investment Plan 2018-2023: Statistical Report
